# Richard Wang

> Personal site of Richard Wang — machine learning engineer in San Francisco
> and co-founder & CEO of Clad Labs (Y Combinator F25). Essays on applied AI
> and infrastructure, notes and updates, media appearances, and press
> coverage of Chad: the Brainrot IDE.

Richard Wang is the co-founder & CEO of Clad Labs (https://cladlabs.ai),
the YC F25 startup behind "Chad: The Brainrot IDE" — an AI coding
environment that keeps developers inside the IDE during model inference.
Before Clad Labs he did ML research on semiconductor-fab time series at a
startup acquired by Tokyo Electron (patent filing, SEMICON 2025 talk), and
studied Computer Science at Caltech, where he played point guard on the
basketball team. Regeneron Scholar; high-school national chess champion
(team).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://richardjdwang.com/): About, selected essays, media
  appearances, press, notes, and FAQ.
- [Writing archive](https://richardjdwang.com/writing): Searchable,
  filterable index of all essays, notes, media, and press.
